text: I'm so sorry to be bothering y'all this late. My daughter is 11 and she been running a temp, it's 38.1 right now. Earlier she bumped her head on the dining table reaching under for her phone, and she cried right away, like loud, then she was fine. She been acting completely normal since, talking my ear off, eating chips. She ain't got no rash or nothing, I checked all over her twice. Her breathing is normal too, I been watching her. I just be overthinking everything when it's her head. Is it okay for her to go to sleep or do I need to keep her up? Sorry again.
